title: Greek Guanciale Lasagna
description: A rich and savory Italian-inspired dish with the addition of Greek flavors.
instructions: Cook lasagna sheets according to package instructions.
In a pan, cook guanciale until crispy, then set aside.
In another pan, sauté onion and garlic until softened.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked lasagna sheets to the pan, stir to coat with sauce.
In a separate saucepan, make bechamel sauce with Greek yogurt and Parmesan cheese.
Assemble lasagna by layering cooked lasagna sheets, guanciale, bechamel sauce, and feta cheese.
Repeat for 2-3 layers, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce and Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
